record_title: Full Morita corners split support tau-tilting gluing into joins and meets
provenance: A strict-Morita-context specialization of the direct-induction and componentwise torsion constructions in arXiv:2609.18746v1, using Morita equivalence and the support tau-tilting/functorially-finite-torsion correspondence.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The matrix-algebra failures of the radical-valued converse and the strict M_2(C) intersection obstruction are prior work in arXiv:2609.18746v1. Morita equivalence of strict contexts and order-preserving correspondences for torsion theories are classical. Older Morita/torsion-theory literature was not exhaustively inspected theorem-by-theorem, so an equivalent join/meet observation under different terminology remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
